title: Gemini parallel functionResponse parts must share one user turn
answers: Gemini 400 error: number of function response parts is not equal to number of function call parts
parallel tool calls fail with Gemini through AI Gateway
Vertex AI parallel function calling returns 400 on tool results
OpenAI-format parallel tool_calls converted to Gemini functionResponse
body:
Symptom: Chat through the AI Gateway's Gemini or Vertex AI provider fails with "400: Please ensure that the number of function response parts is equal to the number of function call parts" whenever the model made parallel tool calls.
Root cause: mlflow/gateway/providers/gemini.py:GeminiAdapter.chat_to_model appended a separate user turn with one functionResponse for every role=="tool" message, but Gemini needs all N responses to a model turn's N functionCall parts in one user turn.
Fix pattern: In the role=="tool" branch, append the functionResponse to the previous content entry when it is a user turn whose parts are all functionResponse; otherwise start a new user turn. Keep it in the single pass over messages.
Constraints: Merge only into a user turn made entirely of functionResponse parts. Sequential rounds stay separate because a model turn sits between them; do not merge across that boundary. _VertexGeminiAdapter inherits chat_to_model, so the fix covers Vertex AI.
applies: Any change to how OpenAI tool/tool_calls messages are converted into Gemini contents in the AI Gateway providers.
says: Parallel tool calls fail with a bad request error on Gemini models.
Vertex AI chat returns an error when submitting multiple tool results at once.
Simultaneous function calls fail with a message about mismatched response parts.
Allow Gemini chat to handle multiple tool outputs returned from parallel executions.
Submitting answers for concurrent tool requests causes an error in gateway chat.
search: When converting OpenAI tool messages to Gemini contents in mlflow/gateway/providers/gemini.py:GeminiAdapter.chat_to_model, parallel tool responses must be grouped into a single user turn. In the role=='tool' branch, functionResponse is appended to the previous user turn only if all its parts are functionResponse, starting a new user turn otherwise. Responses must not be merged across sequential model turn boundaries. Applies to chat_to_model and inherited _VertexGeminiAdapter behavior in AI Gateway providers for both chat and streaming.
